clue.text: Give way and secure some food

parts.note: to give way, as a dam does, is to break
to secure something is to make it fast

explanation.surface: An instruction to yield and grab something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The morning meal is a serving of food eaten early in the day.

clue.text: Gourmet wanting specific sort of pie first

indicators.note: first says the rearranged pie letters come at the front of the answer
a sort of pie is a reworked version, so the three letters are rearranged

parts.note: a specific is an old word for a remedy targeting one disease, a cure

explanation.surface: A food lover who insists on a particular kind of pie before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'specific' looks like an adjective, but here it is the old noun for a remedy aimed at one illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Both name a person of refined taste in food and drink.

clue.text: Clergyman's address according a lot of time to standard issue

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level
issue means offspring, such as a son
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A vicar's sermon giving lengthy attention to some everyday matter of standards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'according ... to' is just glue: AGE is accorded to PAR + SON, in that order.
explanation.definitionFit: A vicarage is the house where a parish priest lives, his official residence.

clue.text: Dashed off, and so made an impression on a top newsman

parts.note: stamped means pressed a mark into something
the editor, abbreviated ED, is the senior journalist on a paper

explanation.surface: Someone stormed out after making a mark on the chief of the newsroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A herd that rushed away in panic did exactly this, a headlong flight.

clue.text: Tape recorder heartlessly set before love

indicators.note: heartlessly means the middle letter of the word set is taken out

parts.note: ere is a poetic word for before
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone coldly sets a cassette deck ahead of affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartlessly' removes the E at the centre of SET to leave ST.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-channel sound system, such as an old cassette deck, is a familiar kind of audio equipment.

clue.text: Hardly a generous period for an interval

parts.note: someone mean is far from generous
a period is a stretch of time

explanation.surface: A stingy spell of time used as a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The time in between two events is an interval, as in the phrase 'in the meantime'.

clue.text: Loiters about in a Portuguese resort

indicators.note: about signals that the letters of loiters are moved around

explanation.surface: Someone idles on holiday at a seaside town in Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: A coastal town near Lisbon, famous for its casino and motor racing circuit.

clue.text: Not free to marry

explanation.surface: A person who is spoken for and cannot wed.
explanation.definitionFit: Busy or occupied (a phone line, a toilet) and also pledged in a promise of matrimony.

clue.text: Cloth worker about 50 getting set again

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric used for upholstery
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
a worker ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: A textile employee of about fifty being reassigned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts L inside ANT, giving ALNT.
explanation.definitionFit: To plant something once more in fresh soil is to put it in the ground a second time.

clue.text: The loss of a good man in earnings

indicators.note: in places the article and the saint inside the pay word

parts.note: a wage is what one earns
ST, for saint, is a good man in crosswords

explanation.surface: Someone mourning the departure of a decent colleague from the payroll.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste or erosion over time, as when staff leave and are not replaced, is natural loss.

clue.text: Person charging a spender round about a hundred

indicators.note: round means the article and spender word wrap the two Cs

parts.note: a user consumes or spends resources
C, short for circa, means about
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Someone running up charges, an extravagant shopper with a bill of roughly a hundred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' sets C (circa) and C (hundred) between A and USER.
explanation.definitionFit: One who brings a charge or allegation against another is a plaintiff or prosecutor.

clue.text: A flower say tucked into say a festive gift

indicators.note: tucked into places the flower and abbreviation inside the second abbreviation

parts.note: again say gives EG, for example
an aster is a daisy-like flower
say means for example, abbreviated EG

explanation.surface: Someone tucking a daisy into a holiday present.
explanation.walkthrough: The flower and its 'say' go inside the second 'say', between its E and its G; the 'a' before 'festive gift' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A chocolate or decorated ovum given at the spring Christian holiday is a seasonal present.

clue.text: Gush in a silly way, causing great distress

indicators.note: in a silly way tells us the letters of gush in a are scrambled foolishly

explanation.surface: Gushing foolishly that results in deep upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe mental or physical suffering is the same as agony.

clue.text: Supporting no-one playing before twelve o'clock

parts.note: to be for something is to support it

indicators.note: playing means the letters of no-one are moved around in play

explanation.surface: Backing nobody in a game held in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: The morning period before midday is an old word for the a.m. hours.

clue.text: Graduate woman showing affection

parts.note: an MA, a Master of Arts, is a graduate
a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A female graduate who displays fondness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affection' is not fondness here but its older medical sense, a disease or ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine an affection is a disorder of the body, an illness.

clue.text: Nowadays the wealthy man holding it gets extras

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the current era

indicators.note: holding means the rich man's name contains the word it

parts.note: Dives is the rich man in the Bible's parable of Lazarus

explanation.surface: In modern times a rich man clutching something takes on bonuses.
explanation.walkthrough: Dives is the traditional name for the rich man in the parable in Luke's Gospel; 'holding' gives DIITVES.
explanation.definitionFit: Substances added to food to preserve or enhance it are supplementary ingredients.

clue.text: An adolescent who's gone rusty, surprisingly

indicators.note: surprisingly tells us gone rusty is rearranged into an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A teenager who has, unexpectedly, got out of practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A young person, especially a child or teenager.

clue.text: A large number following the game made complaints

indicators.note: following means the number letter comes after the game bird

parts.note: grouse is a game bird shot for sport
D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number

explanation.surface: Many people chasing the shooting season grumbled.
explanation.definitionFit: To grumble or moan is to protest.

clue.text: . Concerned with seeing a change for the better

parts.note: re means about or concerning
vision is the faculty of sight

explanation.surface: An eye-related matter that leads to improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment, as of a text, is meant to improve it.

clue.text: Sweet content lies in the smallest of feeding-bottles

indicators.note: content lies in means the answer is found running inside the following words

explanation.surface: Something sweet is found in even the tiniest baby bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A chewy confection made from boiled sugar and butter is a type of candy.

clue.text: Act — in the theatre?

explanation.surface: A stage instruction to perform in a playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' suggests the stage, but it is the operating theatre where surgeons work.
explanation.definitionFit: To function or work, and also what a surgeon does to a patient on the table.

clue.text: A growth industry

parts.note: a phrase for a booming business, read literally as the business of growing crops and livestock

explanation.definitionFit: Agriculture is the trade whose product is things that grow.

clue.text: Spanish agreements covering the French and a Central European area

indicators.note: covering means the two yeses go around the French article

parts.note: si is Spanish for yes, so two agreements are SI SI
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Spanish deals covering France and a region of Central Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: Repeating the Spanish 'yes' makes a plural, 'agreements'; 'covering' means the French article goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A historic region now mostly in Poland, it is a territory of central Europe.

clue.text: Point to publication's incitement to riot

parts.note: S, south, is a compass point
an edition is one publication of a text

explanation.surface: A pointer towards a magazine that stirs up rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech or action urging rebellion against authority is a crime against the state.

clue.text: A designing individual and others accompanying a girl

parts.note: etc, et cetera, means and others
her refers to a girl

explanation.surface: A scheming person and friends escorting a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designing' sounds like scheming, but it means making designs: this artist engraves them.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist who cuts designs into metal plates with acid is a printmaker who draws.

clue.text: Just involving a peer is a safety device!

indicators.note: involving means the fair word wraps around the peer

parts.note: just means right or fair
an earl is a British peer, a nobleman

explanation.surface: It is only fair that a nobleman counts as a safeguard!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just' reads as 'only' in the surface but means fair; 'involving' gives REARLIGHT's middle letters EARL.
explanation.definitionFit: The red lamp at the back of a vehicle or bicycle warns those behind.

clue.text: Malefactors score in disorder

indicators.note: in disorder means the letters of score in are jumbled

explanation.surface: Criminals settle a score amid chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Counterfeiters of money are criminals, wrongdoers.

clue.text: Non-combatant in the main

explanation.surface: A peaceful sailor out on the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is an old word for the open sea; the biggest ocean bears this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Peaceable or peace-loving, and also the name of the largest ocean, the main sea.

clue.text: With little hesitation put out English recluse

parts.note: er is a short pause in speech
to emit is to send out

explanation.surface: After a brief pause, a hermit from England is ejected.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit, especially a religious one living alone.

clue.text: Combine receiving short answer — the bird!

indicators.note: receiving means the business union takes in the short answer

parts.note: a merger is a combine, a joining of businesses
ANS is the abbreviation of answer

explanation.surface: A corporate merger accepting a curt reply is for the birds!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Combine' is the noun, a merger; 'receiving' puts ANS inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fish-eating diving duck with a saw-toothed bill.
